title: Friends in Mallworld
content: So I know we all talk about the university n shit, but does anyone ever have like a set of friends where you guys just run away and fight these people(creatures)?? Like you don’t know these people and when you wake up you probably can’t remember their faces, but YOU KNOW it’s the same people every time. Is anyone else doing this shit like every night. Like I feel like I know them but I don’t.
